pairs: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
and cry out to the ears of Jerusalem,
and on the charity of your betrothal,
quando secuta es me in deserto,
when you followed me into the desert,
into a land which is not sown.
Israel is holy to the Lord,
All those who devour him commit an offense.
Listen to the word of the Lord,
and all you families of the house of Israel.
Quid invenerunt patres vestri in me iniquitatis,
“What iniquity have your fathers found in me,
that they would draw far away from me,
Ubi est Dominus qui ascendere nos fecit de terra Ægypti;
‘Where is the Lord, who caused us to ascend from the land of Egypt;
who led us through the desert,
through an uninhabited and impassable land,
per terram sitis, et imaginem mortis,
through a land of drought and of the image of death,
per terram in qua non ambulavit vir, neque habitavit homo?
through a land in which no one walked and in which no man lived?’
Et induxi vos in terram Carmeli,
And I led you into the land of Carmel,
so that you would eat from its fruit and from its excellence.
et hæreditatem meam posuistis in abominationem.
and you turned my inheritance into an abomination.
And those who held the law did not know me.
et pastores prævaricati sunt in me,
And the prophets prophesied in Baal
Because of this, I will still contend in judgment against you,
and I will dispute with your sons.
Cross over to the isles of Kittim,
et videte si factum est hujuscemodi:
And see if anything like this has ever been done.
See if a nation has ever changed their gods,
et certe ipsi non sunt dii:
though certainly those are not gods.
populus vero meus mutavit gloriam suam in idolum.
Yet truly, my people have exchanged their glory for an idol.
and be utterly desolate, O gates of heaven,
Duo enim mala fecit populus meus:
For my people have done two evils.
and they have dug for themselves cisterns,
broken cisterns that are unable to hold water.
quare ergo factus est in prædam?
Then why has he become a prey?
The lions have roared over him,
and they have uttered their voice.
They have set his land in solitude;
his cities have been burned up,
et non est qui habitet in eis.
and there is no one who lives in them.
Filii quoque Mempheos et Taphnes constupraverunt te usque ad verticem.
Likewise, the sons of Memphis and of Tahpanhes have defiled you, even to the top of the head.
Numquid non istud factum est tibi,
Has this not been done to you because you abandoned the Lord your God,
quia dereliquisti Dominum Deum tuum eo tempore quo ducebat te per viam?
in that time when he was leading you by the way?
Et nunc quid tibi vis in via Ægypti,
And now what do you want from the way of Egypt,
but to drink their turbid water?
et quid tibi cum via Assyriorum,
And what do you want from the way of the Assyrians,
but to drink the water of their river?
Your own malice will reprove you,
and your own apostasy will rebuke you!
it is an evil and bitter thing for you to forsake the Lord your God,
et amarum est reliquisse te Dominum Deum tuum,
and to be without my fear within you,
et non esse timorem mei apud te,
From ancient times, you have broken my yoke;
you have torn apart my bonds,
Non serviam. In omni enim colle sublimi,
‘I will not serve.’ For on every high hill,
you have been debased, O harlot.
Ego autem plantavi te vineam electam,
Yet I planted you as an elect vineyard, with only true seed.
omne semen verum: quomodo ergo conversa es mihi in pravum,
Then how have you been turned away from me, toward that which is depraved,
Even if you wash yourself with soap,
and increase your use of herbal soaps,
maculata es in iniquitate tua coram me,
you are still stained by your iniquity in my sight,
I have not walked after Baal?’
Consider your ways in the steep valley.
so that you may be like a swift runner, following his course.
A wild donkey accustomed to solitude,
in desiderio animæ suæ attraxit ventum amoris sui:
out of the desire in his soul, caught the scent of his lover.
nullus avertet eam: omnes qui quærunt eam non deficient:
Now nothing will turn him away from her. All those who seek her will not cease.
But they will find her in her menstruation.
You should keep your foot from being naked,
and your throat from being thirsty.
‘I have lost hope. I will not do it.
For certainly, I have loved strangers,
and I will walk after them.’
In the same way that a thief is confounded when he has been apprehended,
so the house of Israel has been confounded,
principes, et sacerdotes, et prophetæ eorum,
their leaders and priests and prophets.
For they say to a piece of wood,
They have turned their back to me,
et in tempore afflictionis suæ dicent:
But in the time of their affliction,
Ubi sunt dii tui quos fecisti tibi?
Where are your gods that you made for yourselves?
Let them rise up and deliver you in the time of your affliction.
et liberent te in tempore afflictionis tuæ:
secundum numerum quippe civitatum tuarum erant dii tui,
your gods were like the number of your cities,
Why do you want to contend against me in judgment?
I have struck your children to no effect;
Your own sword has devoured your prophets.
Your generation is like a raging lion.
Consider the word of the Lord.
Have I become like a wilderness to Israel,
or like a land late to bear fruit?
quare ergo dixit populus meus: Recessimus;
Then why have my people said, ‘We are withdrawing;
we will no longer approach you’?
Numquid obliviscetur virgo ornamenti sui, aut sponsa fasciæ pectoralis suæ?
Can a virgin forget her ornament, or a bride the covering across her breast?
populus vero meus oblitus est mei diebus innumeris.
Yet truly, my people have forgotten me, for innumerable days.
Quid niteris bonam ostendere viam tuam ad quærendam dilectionem,
Why are you striving to claim that your way is good,
as if to seek my love,
et malitias tuas docuisti vias tuas,
when all the while you are also displaying your malice by your own way,
et in alis tuis inventus est sanguis animarum pauperum
and in your armpits there is found the blood of poor and innocent souls?
sed in omnibus quæ supra memoravi.
but everywhere that I mentioned previously.
Absque peccato et innocens ego sum,
‘I am innocent and without sin. And because of this,
et propterea avertatur furor tuus a me.
let your fury be turned away from me.’
Behold, I will contend with you in judgment,
How exceedingly vile you have become,
repeating your ways again and again!
And so, you will be ashamed of Egypt,
just as you were ashamed of Assur.
For you will also depart from that place,
et manus tuæ erunt super caput tuum:
and your hand will be upon your head.
For the Lord has crushed your confidence,
et nihil habebis prosperum in ea.
and you will have nothing prosperous by it.”
